changes.summary: Bound this recipe to the evidence-backed model capability authority without changing runtime behavior.

changes.details: The recipe now carries every author-selectable Podman build input through the signed Controller-to-agent request, including a bounded capability list that defaults to empty. The agent drops all capabilities before adding only declared allowlisted entries inside Podman's rootless user namespace; host privilege, devices, mounts, sockets, security options, storage, cgroups, and generated image identity remain fixed platform policy.
changes.summary: Declared explicit resource limits and rootless capabilities in the portable recipe build contract.
Declared explicit recipe alignment metadata; no runtime behavior changed.
Rejected symlinked, empty, and over-16 MiB image inputs before loading the Pixal3D pipeline.
Exposed the pinned nvdiffrast dependency's non-commercial research and evaluation restriction on the recipe card.
Required embedded UV, base-color, and metallic-roughness PBR data on a valid triangle mesh before atomic GLB publication.
Loaded FlexGEMM's shipped autotune cache read-only and disabled runtime cache writes for UID 10001.
Validated image input before model loading and structurally validated GLB output before atomic publication.
Declared exact one-image input and single-GLB output slots with bounded bytes.
Replaced the metadata-only checkpoint binding with a real pinned Pixal3D image-to-GLB execution path.
Added local DINOv3 and NAF, native mesh dependencies, bounded camera calibration, and ARM64 SDPA without runtime downloads.
Kept Candidate status until the reproducible offline build and workload pass a physical DGX Spark canary.
Marked the checkpoint binding non-executable pending its TRELLIS.2 source, native extensions, and GLB adapter.
Added the authoritative isolated image input contract.
Corrected the checkpoint license to MIT.
Initial reviewed catalog release of Pixal3D pytorch-pipeline single Spark.
Recovered the first public legacy revision from before semantic release tracking.
